sentences.en: When I went out in the morning, the weather was nice, so I didn't bring an umbrella.
When school ended in the afternoon, it had started raining, and I'd forgotten to bring an umbrella.
I stood at the door, looking at the rain, not knowing how to get home.
My classmate Xiaomei saw me and said: "I have an umbrella, you can use mine."
We walked home together, and I said: "Thank you!"
By the time I got home, my clothes weren't wet.

quiz.q: What did the writer forget to bring?
Who lends the writer an umbrella?
What happens to the writer's clothes by the time she gets home?

grammar.p: 忘了带（to forget to bring something）
grammar.e: 忘了 followed by 带 and an object means you forgot to bring that thing along.
grammar.x: 我忘了带伞。— I forgot to bring my umbrella.

grammar.p: 不知道 + 怎么 + V（not knowing how to do something）
grammar.e: 不知道 followed by 怎么 and a verb expresses not knowing how to do something.
grammar.x: 我站在门口，看着雨，不知道怎么回家。— I stood at the door, looking at the rain, not knowing how to get home.

grammar.e: 可以 offers permission or an option, often used when lending something to someone.
grammar.x: 我有伞，你可以用我的。— I have an umbrella, you can use mine.
